items.title: Ask Maps gets more helpful with food ordering and more
items.summary: From agentic food ordering to real time transit information, the latest Ask Maps improvements make it easier than ever to get more done.

items.title: From assistance to execution: How enterprises put AI to work
items.summary: Two new reports show how AI adoption is spreading across firms and workers—and what frontier organizations are doing differently.

items.title: Testing ads in ChatGPT
items.summary: Ads that support free access and don’t change ChatGPT answers. Update on August 11, 2026: ChatGPT Ads has now launched in the United Kingdom, Mexico, Brazil, Japan, and South Korea.

items.title: Daybreak models are now available on AWS
items.summary: Earlier this year, OpenAI frontier models and Codex became generally available on AWS, giving enterprises a new path to bring advanced AI into production.

items.title: Putting sign language AI into users’ hands
items.summary: Introducing sign-language-to-text (SL2T), our breakthrough model powering new sign language features for Deaf and hard of hearing users.

items.title: AMIE, our research medical AI system, demonstrates real-time clinical video consultation capabilities in a first-of-its-kind study.
items.summary: When you visit a doctor, a consultation extends far beyond words — a physician notices a cough, observes gait, or registers visible signs of discomfort.

items.title: NVIDIA AI Factory Compute Is Becoming an Investable Asset Class
items.summary: We announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent financing platforms designed to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital to support the buildout of AI infrastructure over time.
